text: Based on the evidence, **not all** of the 2021 loss was inside the pine plantation. The total loss area was **81.3 ha**, of which **68.1 ha (84%)** occurred within the planted pine forest (*Pinus elliottii y Pinus taeda*) and **13.2 ha (16%)** occurred outside mapped forest areas. The loss was corroborated by multiple datasets, including Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020, with 98% of the event area confirmed as forest in 2020. The 13.2 ha outside the plantation suggests the loss extended beyond the pine forest boundaries.
